name_en: SC/ST Pre Matric Scholarship - Uttar Pradesh

version.benefit_text_en: Day students receive up to ₹3,500 per year, and residential students receive up to ₹8,000 per year depending on the component.
not_checked_en: For Component 1, the family's annual income must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000.
Students whose parents are in occupations traditionally considered untouchable are eligible under Component 2.
Applicants cannot hold another scholarship at the same time, except as allowed by rules.
Must provide bank passbook photocopy, fee receipt number, enrollment number, and passport photo.
